sentences.en: Richa rose to prominence after her third album, titled "Moonlight Whispers".
sentences.zh: Richa在第三张专辑《月光低语》发行后声名鹊起。

sentences.en: His chin had the prominence and squareness which mark the man of determination.
sentences.zh: 他的下巴突出且方正，彰显出一个有决心的人的特征。

sentences.en: With the appearance of a promising new writer, the aging novelist fell from prominence.
sentences.zh: 随着一位有前途的新作家出现，这位老小说家失去了往日的显赫地位。

senses.zh: 突出，显著，卓越，重要；突出物，明显

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pro（向前）+min（突出）+ ence→向前突出→突出物
